help.clock.title: For videos that show the same clock.
help.clock: With both videos playing, click “Find clocks”: the extension looks for the timers that tick along with each video, like the match clock in the game and in the reaction. You can also mark each clock by hand, or pause and type the times.
help.timeline.title: For videos without a visible clock.
help.timeline: Pause both videos and put them on the same scene, or the point the creator told you. Then mark the moment. Syncing keeps that relation between the videos.
fine.label: Fine adjustment
fine.title: Make it yours
fine.sub: Shift video B against the reference.
fine.minus: Delay video B by half a second
fine.plus: Advance video B by half a second
help.p1: It controls HTML5 videos in Chrome, including players embedded from other sites, with access only to the sites you connect. No account, and no image ever leaves your computer.
help.p2: With clocks, each player is read directly and B is adjusted as soon as several readings agree. If a live player can’t rewind, the video that is ahead pauses for the difference. Halftime, replays or a frozen clock pause the adjustments until the clocks agree again.
help.p3: In “Same moment” mode, pauses and positions of A guide B. Cuts, ads, episode changes and pauses inside a reaction may need a new reference.
help.p4: Keep this window open. DRM-protected players can still be read through a tab capture; TVs and apps outside the browser are not supported. Closing the window stops syncing and leaves the videos where they are.

status.welcome.detail: Choose the two tabs to begin.
status.stopped.detail: You can adjust the videos and start again.
status.tryDemo.detail: To connect real tabs, load the extension folder in Chrome.
status.embedded: The video is in a player from another site
status.embedded.detail: This page uses a player from {sites}. Click “{button}”.
status.bothConnected.detail: Find the clocks, or line the videos up and mark the moment.
status.oneConnected.detail: Connect the other video to continue.
status.jumped.detail: Halftime, a replay or a content change? Check both clocks and start again.
status.holding.follower: This player can’t rewind, so video B pauses for {n} s until A catches up.
status.holding.reference: Video B can’t skip ahead, so A pauses for {n} s until B catches up.
status.liveJump.detail: This player jumps to live when resumed, so pausing can’t delay it. Use a player that can rewind, or swap the sides.
status.marked.detail: When you start, both videos play. Only video B gets adjustments.
status.started.ocr: Reading the clocks from the players. Adjustments start after a few matching readings.
status.started.timeline: Keeping the videos together. Mark again if the content has cuts or pauses.
status.contentChanged.detail: Connect the right video and set a new reference.
status.ad.detail: Syncing stopped. Set the reference again when the content is back.
status.loading: Waiting for the videos to load
status.loading.detail: Adjustments resume once both players are steady.
status.pickSameTab.detail: This player doesn’t let its image be read directly. In Chrome’s window, choose the tab of video {side}.
status.captureEnded.detail: Select the clock again to keep reading it.
status.clocksReady.detail: Click “Start syncing”. The extension reads both clocks and adjusts video B by itself.
status.oneClock.detail: Select the clock of the other video.
status.finding.detail: Keep both videos playing. It takes a few seconds.
status.cancelled.detail: You can try again or use the manual reference.
status.mode.clock: With both videos playing, click “Find clocks”.
status.mode.timeline: Pause and line up both videos, then mark the moment.
status.connectSelected.detail: Changing the tab clears the previous reference.
status.playerPicked.detail: Set a new reference for this video.
status.direction.detail: Set a new reference or start reading both clocks.
status.paused.detail: Line them up or type the clocks before marking the reference.
status.capturesCleared.detail: Image reading is off. The manual reference is still available.
status.reading.detail: The first reading can take a few seconds.
status.checkRead.detail: Compare them with the screen and click “Apply typed times”.
status.demo.detail: The clocks are simulated. Apply the typed times and start syncing.
status.drift.running: Watch the automatic correction on the next cycle.
status.drift.idle: Start syncing to test the correction.
error.permission: Access to this site wasn’t granted. You can try again.
error.permissionPlayer: Access to the player wasn’t granted. You can try again.
error.sameVideo: Pick two different videos. This one is already connected on the other side.
error.noVideo: No video found. Press play on the page and try again.
error.pauseFirst: Pause both videos before marking the reference, so the times don’t move while you set it up.
error.adCalibrate: Wait for the ad to end before marking.
error.cantReach: Video B can’t reach that moment. Try swapping the tabs or using a player that can rewind.
error.busyStart: Wait for the current reading to finish before starting.
error.oneCapture: Select the clock on both videos, or stop reading clocks to use the manual reference.
error.sameSpeed: Set the same playback speed on both videos.
error.adStart: Wait for the ad to end before starting.
error.contentChanged: The content changed. Set a new reference.
error.playToGrab: Press play on the video so its image loads, then try again.
error.playBoth: Press play on both videos and try again.
error.busy: Wait for the current reading to finish.
error.pauseToRead: Pause both videos to read and check the times before applying them.
error.changedWhileReading: The videos moved during the reading. Pause again and repeat.
error.lowConfidence: Couldn’t read with confidence. Mark a sharper area or type the times.
grab.notReady: Press play on the video so its image loads.
grab.protected: This player doesn’t let its image be read directly.
bridge.playerChanged: The player changed. Connect this tab again.
bridge.playBlocked: Click play on the video itself to allow playback.
bridge.notSeekable: The player doesn’t offer that part. The live may not allow rewinding.
bridge.failed: Couldn’t reach the video. Connect the tab again.
ocr.missing: The local reading files are missing. Use the complete extension folder.
capture.stopped: The capture stopped. Select the clock again.
capture.pickTab: Choose a browser tab, not the whole screen or a window.
reason.ad: Ad detected. Set the reference again after the ad.
reason.loading: Waiting for the video to load.
reason.speed: Use the same speed on both videos.
reason.tooFar: Difference above 30 s. Pause, check the clocks and apply the times by hand.
reason.unavailable: That moment isn’t available to rewind or skip to in this player.
reason.unreadable: Clock unreadable. Waiting for a clear reading.
reason.changed: Clock changed or stopped. Confirming the new reference…
reason.frozen: Clock stopped. Waiting for it to move…
